mapper.select: SELECT AVG(star_rating) AS avgRating, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS reviewCount FROM dish_evaluation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dish_id = #{dishId} AND status = 1
SELECT star_rating AS starRating, COUNT(*) AS count FROM dish_evaluation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dish_id = #{dishId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY star_rating ORDER BY star_rating DESC
